description: Land Title Settlement Department  -   Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1845/25 of 19.05.2014, Moratuwa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, land extents, and amendments to land title records for various properties in different locations. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
